name: Linaris
source:
Rumours of a girl in white roaming the depths of Ishgalia soon reach the ears of Orias and his compatriots. When they do save Linaris from a rival adventuring party on a commission to capture and enslave her, they discover she has amnesia and only remembers her name and who Orias is. Linaris resembles someone very closely from the dreams Orias periodically has, so who is she and how is she able to wander the dungeons unharmed?

[Spoiler] Linaris is created from the bloodspring of life from the one wish of Magna's daughter to see Orias once more. As such, she is capable of healing herself from the most grievous of wounds because of the spring's properties. Although biologically identical to Magna's daughter, she is not quite the same person Orias has been searching for. [/Spoiler]

Linaris' innocent nature makes her popular amongst the underground denizens and Orias' compatriots alike. Despite her amnesia, she hides a few surprises in her vocabulary range...
